title: Check if the Bluetooth adapter is on and not blocked
summary: Check three things in order: the Bluetooth service is running, the radio is not switched off by rfkill, and the adapter is powered on. These read-only checks change nothing.
prerequisites: A computer with a Bluetooth adapter

steps.explain: Check that the Bluetooth service is running. Look for 'Active: active (running)'. If it says inactive or failed, the service is stopped and the other checks will not help.

alternatives.explain: Print only the one-word state of the service. The answer 'active' means it runs.

steps.explain: Check whether rfkill has blocked the radio. 'Soft blocked: no' and 'Hard blocked: no' mean it is free. 'Soft blocked: yes' means software turned it off. 'Hard blocked: yes' means a hardware switch or function key is off. 'command not found' means install the rfkill package first.
steps.expect: Soft blocked: no and Hard blocked: no

steps.explain: Check that the Bluetooth adapter is powered on. 'Powered: yes' means the adapter is on. 'Powered: no' means it is off. 'No default controller available' means the system found no Bluetooth adapter at all.
steps.expect: Powered: yes, and a Controller line with a MAC address

source.title: bluetoothctl manual; card written and verified in the lnxhelp sandbox
